principiante.n: Machine cardio (cycling, spinning, elliptical) · Beginner — Technique 1
principiante.d: Warm-up: 5 min at a very easy pace, low resistance. — Continuous block: 20 min at a steady pace, low-medium resistance, comfortable cadence (~70-80 rpm if cycling). — Cool-down: 5 min minimal resistance + quad, hamstring and calf stretches.

intermedio.d: Warm-up: 15 min with progressive warm-up routes. — Project routes: Repeated attempts on 2-3 routes slightly above your comfortable level. — Cool-down: Forearm and shoulder stretches + finger decompression, 10 min.

Warm-up: 15 min with progressive warm-up routes. — Endurance: Continuous circuit of linked easy routes, 15-20 min without stopping. — Cool-down: Forearm and shoulder stretches + finger decompression, 10 min.

Warm-up: 15 min with progressive warm-up routes. — Strength block: 4-5 medium-difficulty boulder problems, with full rest between attempts. — Cool-down: Forearm and shoulder stretches + finger decompression, 10 min.

Warm-up: 15 min with progressive warm-up routes. — Antagonists: 3 sets x 12 reverse wrist curls or similar, to protect the tendons. — Cool-down: Forearm and shoulder stretches + finger decompression, 10 min.
